items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: The interviewee (Arthur Vigne) discusses his father and brother. Bill Russell is identified in the transcript only as the interviewer ('this is Bill Russell, so we identify our voices on the tape'). There is no evidence of a personal or professional relationship between Arthur Vigne and Bill Russell

ctx.x: Well, he played up until a year before he died. He stood sick in bed a year and died one year before he died. Because my mother died when I was 12. And then right after she died, he took sick and he died a year later, a year after her.

I was wondering if we saw that picture, of course, that Russell copied of the Peerless band. And I understand that Bab Frank and McCurdy were sort of the leaders of that at one period. Do you remember who was really the leader at the time your father played? Of this particular band? Yes, that picture you have.
I don't really remember who was the leader of the band, but most of the time in the days when he was playing the trumpet player always was leading the band.
